title: Building – Meeting the requirements of exposing building face – November 2016
description: A home builder constructed a house with a secondary suite that encroached within 1.2 m of the property line, by 0.01 m to 0.05 m. The north wall had two glazed openings.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an s.49 order; no alternative solution was submitted

outcome_summary: Order confirmed. The encroachment exceeded the 2% dimensional tolerance in ABC 2006 Div C 2.2.2.4, and ABC 2006 Table 9.10.15.4 allows zero glazed area at under 1.2 m limiting distance.
